description:
What if the world ended tomorrow, and you had to survive it day by day? Welcome to DoodleSurvival, your home for animated survival stories, zombie outbreaks and end-of-the-world challenges. 🧟

DoodleSurvival follows one ordinary guy in a red trucker cap as he tries to last through disasters that would break most people. No superpowers, no lucky airdrops. Just water, food, wits and some very bad nights. 😰

What you will find here:

* Day-by-Day Survival Stories: From Day 1 to Day 30 and beyond, every decision counts.
* Zombie Outbreaks & Apocalypse Scenarios: Farms, cities and hideouts overrun by the infected.
* Real Survival Lessons & Creepy Mysteries: Practical tips mixed with radio voices, strange notes and knocks in the night.

Subscribe to DoodleSurvival (because I'm gonna be homeless soon) and join the survivors as we take on the end of the world, one day at a time. New videos drop weekly!
